design: single-arm phase 2 basket (Simon two-stage)
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility: 'other tumors meeting staging and DLL3 criteria' explicitly accepts non-SCLC tumors with DLL3 IHC expression. Excludes de novo SCLC and de novo NEPC. Patient's RNA expression alone is insufficient — DLL3 IHC at ≥25% (preferable for stage 1 entry) or ≥1% (stage 2) is the gating biomarker. Inpatient observation required for cycle-1 step-up dosing per CRS-mitigation protocol.
intervention_dosing: 1 mg IV step dose D1, 10 mg D8/D15 cycle 1, then 10 mg q2w (28-day cycles)

biomarker: DLL3 (no IHC threshold required for enrollment)
design: open-label phase 2 dose-evaluation
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: trial enrolls SCLC, not osteosarcoma — patient is NOT enrollable here. Included for mechanism-of-action evidence: this is the pivotal trial that drove tarlatamab's FDA accelerated approval and the reason the basket trial NCT06788938 exists. CRS ~50% (mostly grade 1-2; grade ≥3 ~1%); ICANS-like neurologic events ~10%; step-up dosing with inpatient cycle-1 monitoring.
intervention_dosing: 1 mg step dose D1, then 10 mg q2w (target dose)

design: randomized phase 3 (tarlatamab vs investigator's choice chemotherapy)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: confirmatory phase-3 in SCLC, not enrollable for an osteosarcoma patient. Included as the highest-quality clinical-efficacy evidence for the tarlatamab mechanism — median OS 13.6 vs 8.3 mo. Establishes the mechanistic basis the board uses when evaluating whether tarlatamab is worth pursuing via the basket trial for a non-SCLC patient.

design: randomized phase 3 (obrixtamig + atezolizumab + carboplatin/etoposide vs SOC)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC frontline, not enrollable for osteosarcoma. Surfaces the second BiTE deeply in pivotal development behind tarlatamab — Boehringer Ingelheim's lead DLL3 program. Pipeline evidence the board needs to see when reasoning about DLL3 BiTE class activity.

indication: DLL3-expressing SCLC, large-cell NEC, neuroendocrine prostate cancer, GEP-NEC
design: open-label phase 1/2, monotherapy + atezolizumab + ifinatamab deruxtecan combinations
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolls SCLC + NEC, not osteosarcoma — patient is not enrollable. Trispecific T-cell engager (DLL3 × CD3 × albumin-binding domain) — distinct mechanism class from tarlatamab, half-life-extended. Decision-relevant context for the BiTE class.

design: randomized phase 3 (alveltamig vs topotecan)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC, not osteosarcoma. Trispecific (DLL3 × DLL3 × CD3) — bivalent DLL3 binding distinguishes mechanism from monovalent BiTEs; potentially active at lower DLL3 surface densities. Most-advanced trispecific in pivotal development.

design: phase 1 dose-finding ± tocilizumab
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC/NEC. Trispecific DLL3 × CD3 × CD137 — co-stimulation arm aims to extend T-cell persistence and reduce exhaustion vs first-gen BiTEs. Phase 1 completed; future-development status uncertain.

design: phase 1/2 dose-escalation + expansion ± carbo/etoposide / paclitaxel / atezolizumab
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: NEC umbrella, not osteosarcoma. Bispecific DLL3 × CD47 — combines DLL3 targeting with macrophage 'don't-eat-me' blockade; mechanism distinct from CD3 BiTEs/trispecifics. Decision-relevant as alternative non-T-cell-engager bispecific path.

indication: advanced solid tumors with DLL3 expression
design: phase 1 dose-finding
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: 'advanced solid tumors with DLL3 expression' is in principle pan-tumor but in practice enrolls SCLC/NEC. Recruitment status currently UNKNOWN — confirm directly with sponsor before relying on enrollment availability.

journal: ClinicalTrials.gov record (FDA Fast Track for ES-SCLC)
design: randomized phase 3 (zocilurtatug pelitecan vs investigator's choice)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC. First DLL3 ADC in pivotal phase-3 since Rova-T's TAHOE failure — TOP1-inhibitor payload (different from Rova-T's PBD warhead). FDA Fast Track for ES-SCLC. Most decision-relevant ADC for the post-Rova-T era.

design: phase 1/2 ± durvalumab / IDE161
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-tumor 'DLL3-expressing tumors' arm in principle accepts non-SCLC malignancies — confirm with sponsor whether osteosarcoma is on the eligibility list. TOP1-inhibitor payload ADC (similar class to ZL-1310).

design: phase 1 dose-escalation + expansion
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC. DLL3/exatecan ADC — exatecan is a TOP1-inhibitor closely related to DXd. Innovent's entry into the DLL3 ADC race; cleared INDs in multiple countries.

design: phase 1 dose-finding
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolls 'advanced solid tumors' but in practice is SCLC/LCNEC-weighted. DXd-payload ADC; preclinical/early-development data only. Mainland-China program.

design: phase 1 dose-finding
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC/LCNEC. Actinium-225 alpha-particle radiopharmaceutical — radiation mechanism is independent of T-cell function and antigen-loss escape. Currently active not recruiting (data lockup phase).

design: phase 1 (with companion ⁸⁹Zr-DFO-SC16.56 PET imaging on NCT04199741)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: NET focus. Lutetium-177 beta-particle radioimmunotherapy — paired with the ⁸⁹Zr-SC16.56 imaging companion (NCT04199741) for theranostic dosimetry. Memorial Sloan Kettering academic program.

design: phase 1 (²²⁵Ac-ETN029 therapy + ¹¹¹In-ETN029 imaging)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolls multiple NEC types but not osteosarcoma. Actinium-225 radioligand with companion indium-111 imaging — Novartis's entry into the DLL3 radioligand therapy space.

design: phase 1 autologous CAR-T dose-finding
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC/LCNEC. Autologous DLL3 CAR-T — distinct from BiTE / ADC / radioligand mechanism class; persistence and CRS profile differ. Currently active not recruiting.

design: phase 1 autologous CAR-T (legacy first-generation DLL3 CAR-T)
inclusion_match_notes: Legacy: Amgen's first-generation DLL3 CAR-T program. Trial currently SUSPENDED — no public registration of restart. Decision-relevant as the precedent program LB2102 and other CAR-T entrants are following.

design: phase 1 allogeneic DLL3-CAR-NK cell infusion
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC. Allogeneic CAR-NK — off-the-shelf cell therapy class with theoretically lower CRS / GvHD profile vs CAR-T. Status currently UNKNOWN per registry; verify directly. Tianjin academic program.

design: randomized phase 3 (Rova-T vs topotecan, TAHOE)
inclusion_match_notes: Legacy: TAHOE was the pivotal phase-3 that showed Rova-T worse OS vs topotecan, leading AbbVie to discontinue the program. Decision-relevant context: every current DLL3 ADC entrant (ZL-1310, SHR-4849, IBI3009, FZ-AD005) is engineered around the lessons of this failure (PBD-warhead-related toxicity, antigen-density mismatch). Read alongside any DLL3 ADC recommendation.

design: phase 1 (legacy second-generation DLL3 ADC)
inclusion_match_notes: Legacy: Stemcentrx's second DLL3 ADC (PBD payload, distinct linker from Rova-T). Terminated phase 1 — never reached pivotal development. Decision-relevant only as historical context for the PBD-payload class that the field has since moved away from.

indication: previously untreated HLA-A*02:01-positive advanced cutaneous melanoma
design: open-label phase 3 (brenetafusp + nivolumab vs nivolumab ± relatlimab)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: cutaneous melanoma 1L, not osteosarcoma. Patient is NOT enrollable. Mechanism context: brenetafusp is the lead PRAME × CD3 ImmTAC bispecific in pivotal development. HLA-A*02:01 restriction applies to all ImmTAC programs.

indication: advanced solid tumors expressing PRAME (cutaneous and uveal melanoma, ovarian, lung, sarcoma cohorts)
design: phase 1/2 brenetafusp monotherapy + combinations (pembrolizumab, chemo, tebentafusp, bevacizumab, kinase inhibitors)
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-tumor PRAME+/HLA-A*02:01+ basket — sarcoma cohort exists but currently active not recruiting. Confirm with Immunocore medical affairs whether the sarcoma slot accepts osteosarcoma and whether a re-opening or successor protocol is planned. Patient must be HLA-A*02:01-positive to be eligible.

indication: previously treated HLA-A*02:01-positive cutaneous malignant melanoma
design: randomized phase 3 (IMA203 PRAME-TCR-T vs investigator's choice)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: melanoma 2L+, not osteosarcoma. Patient not enrollable here. Pivotal phase-3 for the lead PRAME-TCR-T program. HLA-A*02:01 restriction.

indication: refractory / recurrent solid tumors expressing PRAME (basket: melanoma, sarcomas including synovial sarcoma + osteosarcoma, ovarian, NSCLC, head and neck, uterine, others)
design: open-label phase 1/2 (IMA203 ± IMA203CD8 product) — ACTengine pan-solid basket
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-solid PRAME+ / HLA-A*02:01+ basket — sarcoma cohort explicitly named. Most actionable PRAME pathway for osteosarcoma if both biomarkers confirm. Patient must be HLA-A*02:01-positive AND PRAME IHC-positive at the protocol's threshold (typically ≥1% by IHC). Lymphodepleting chemotherapy (Cy/Flu) precedes T-cell infusion. CRS and neurotoxicity monitoring required.

design: phase 1 (IMA203 PRAME-TCR-T + mRNA-4203 PRAME mRNA vaccine combination)
inclusion_match_notes: Synovial sarcoma is in scope; osteosarcoma is NOT named. The combo design (TCR-T + mRNA boost) is mechanism-relevant context for PRAME-targeting in sarcoma broadly. Patient is not enrollable here as written; ACTengine NCT03686124 is the pan-solid PRAME basket for an osteosarcoma patient.

design: phase 1 first-in-human dose-escalation
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-tumor PRAME-positive HLA-A*02:01-positive eligibility — non-melanoma tumors are accepted in principle. Confirm with Immunocore medical affairs whether sarcoma is on the per-protocol list. Next-generation ImmTAC successor to brenetafusp. Patient must be HLA-A*02:01-positive AND PRAME IHC-positive.

indication: refractory / recurrent solid tumors expressing PRAME
design: phase 1/2 dose-finding (IMA402 phases Ia / Ib / II)
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-solid PRAME-positive basket. Distinct mechanism class from IMA203: IMA402 is a soluble TCR-bispecific (TCER platform) — half-life-extended PRAME × CD3 engager; mechanism-bridge between brenetafusp ImmTAC and IMA203 TCR-T. Sarcoma fit unconfirmed; verify with Immatics medical affairs.

design: phase 1/2 BPX-701 PRAME-TCR with iCasp9 safety switch + rimiducid
inclusion_match_notes: Legacy: Bellicum's PRAME-TCR with inducible-caspase-9 safety switch. Trial TERMINATED. Decision-relevant only as historical context for first-generation PRAME-TCR programs.

indication: DLL3-expressing solid tumors (pan-tumor: melanoma, medullary thyroid, sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma, esthesioneuroblastoma, bladder, testicular, glioblastoma, cervical, LCNEC, NSCLC, Merkel cell)
biomarker: DLL3 ≥1% by IHC (histologies with ≥50% prevalence of ≥1% positivity)
design: phase 1/2 tarlatamab + concurrent or sequential radiation therapy
inclusion_match_notes: The condition list is pan-tumor and gated on DLL3 IHC positivity rather than a single histology, so a DLL3 IHC-positive osteosarcoma could be considered under the 'high-grade tumors with high DLL3 prevalence, including but not limited to' language — confirm bone sarcoma is on the per-protocol list. The patient's RNA-only signal is insufficient; DLL3 IHC ≥1% is the gate. Radiation-plus-BiTE design adds an abscopal rationale on top of the tarlatamab mechanism already central to this case.

indication: SCLC and other DLL3-expressing solid tumors (LCNEC, EP-NEC, GEP-NEC, NEC of bladder)
design: phase 1/2 theranostic pair: [212Pb]Pb-MP0712 therapy with [203Pb]Pb-MP0712 imaging
inclusion_match_notes: The title names 'other DLL3-expressing solid tumors' but the enrolling conditions are all neuroendocrine, so an osteosarcoma patient is not enrollable as written. The row adds a DLL3 program absent from prior screening: a lead-212 alpha-emitter DesignedAnkyrinRepeatProtein radioligand paired with a lead-203 imaging surrogate for theranostic dosimetry. Its radiation mechanism does not depend on T-cell function or surface-antigen density in the way the BiTEs do.

indication: SCLC and neuroendocrine neoplasms (NEPC, GEP-NEC, Merkel cell, LCNEC, EP-NEC)
design: phase 1 dose-finding, q3w IV
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: the enrolling conditions are SCLC and other neuroendocrine neoplasms, not bone sarcoma. Included because BL-M14D1 is a DLL3 antibody-drug conjugate program (SystImmune) not surfaced by the earlier entity-anchored screen, widening the ADC slice of the DLL3 pipeline the board reviews alongside ZL-1310, SHR-4849, and IBI3009.

biomarker: NG2-positive AND DLL3-positive (IHC or flow cytometry)
design: phase 1/2 autologous dual-target CAR-T
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolls melanoma only, so the patient cannot enroll. Kept because it rides the DLL3 handle through a construct type not previously captured — a dual-antigen NG2/DLL3 CAR-T that requires DLL3 positivity by IHC or flow. Dual targeting is a distinct escape-mitigation strategy the board should weigh against single-antigen DLL3 CAR-T.

indication: R/R SCLC and select NECs (EP-NEC, GEP-NEC, NEPC)
design: first-in-human phase 1 autologous potency-enhanced DLL3 CAR-T
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC and select neuroendocrine carcinomas, not bone sarcoma. Adds a distinct DLL3 CAR-T program (Moonlight Bio) beyond the LB2102 and AMG 119 rows already on file — a potency-enhanced autologous construct still pre-recruitment. Informational until the platform reports first-in-human safety.

design: phase 1/2 DLL3-targeted CAR-T
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: ES-SCLC only, not enrollable for this patient. Kept as a distinct DLL3 CAR-T entrant (Novartis) that widens the cell-therapy slice of the pipeline; its allowance of prior DLL3-targeted therapy is notable for sequencing questions the board may raise.

design: first-in-human phase 1 iPSC-derived anti-DLL3 CAR-NK with IL-2 support after lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: SCLC and neuroendocrine tumors, not bone sarcoma. Distinct from the earlier primary-NK CAR-NK row — this is an iPSC-derived off-the-shelf anti-DLL3 CAR-NK platform, dosed D1/D4/D7 with IL-2 after cyclophosphamide lymphodepletion. Adds the iPSC-CAR-NK manufacturing route to the DLL3 dossier.
intervention_dosing: IV D1/D4/D7 with IL-2 6 mIU D1/D4/D7/D10 after Cy lymphodepletion
sponsor: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

indication: metastatic/unresectable synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma
design: phase 2 brenetafusp monotherapy in rare sarcomas
inclusion_match_notes: The named histologies are synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma, so osteosarcoma is not on the enrolling list. It rides the patient's exact PRAME/HLA-A*02:01 handle in a sarcoma setting, which is why it belongs in the dossier even though the patient cannot enroll: it is the NCI's dedicated sarcoma test of the lead PRAME ImmTAC and anchors the sarcoma-specific precedent for that mechanism. Enrollment requires HLA-A*02:01 positivity.

design: phase 1 dose-escalation, TCR-engineered T cells after lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-solid eligibility ('advanced solid tumors' with central-lab PRAME positivity and HLA-A*02:01) admits non-melanoma histologies in principle, so an osteosarcoma patient could be considered if both biomarkers confirm — verify sarcoma is accepted with the sponsor. This is a PRAME TCR-T program not captured by the earlier screen, ECOG 0-1 required, RECIST-measurable disease required. Both handles (PRAME protein and HLA-A*02:01) must be positive.

design: phase 1 dose-escalation, PRAME TCR-engineered NK cells with Cy/Flu lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolls checkpoint-refractory melanoma only, so the patient cannot enroll. It rides the PRAME/HLA-A*02:01 handle through a modality absent from prior screening — TCR-engineered NK cells rather than TCR-T — which the board may weigh for its distinct persistence and toxicity profile. HLA-A*02:01 positivity required.

indication: recurrent endometrial and platinum-resistant ovarian cancer
design: phase 1 dose-escalation and expansion
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: enrolling conditions are endometrial and platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, not bone sarcoma. Kept as a novel PRAME program (Outpace Bio) riding the patient's handle, and it widens the restriction to HLA-A*02:02 alongside A*02:01 — relevant context if the patient's typing falls in the A*02:02 subgroup. Requires PRAME positivity plus a qualifying HLA-A*02 allele.

design: phase 1/2 PRAME TCR-engineered NK cells with lymphodepleting chemotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor and cross-lineage: enrolls AML and MDS/CMML, not a solid tumor, so the patient cannot enroll. It shares the PRAME/HLA-A*02:01 handle and adds the TCR-NK modality in a myeloid setting, showing the board that PRAME TCR-NK is being tested across both solid and hematologic disease. HLA-A*02:01 positivity required.
